sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 is an image editing model developed by Qwen that performs guided image-to-image transformations using text prompts and reference images. The model accepts multiple input images and generates edited outputs that blend them according to textual instructions while preserving subject identity and visual consistency.
